[THE SKILL SIGNAL]{.eyebrow}

## Tools matter. Judgment connects them.

::: {.section-intro}
Pharmaceutical analysis combines technical tools with knowledge of the underlying data. Explore the tools, vendors and datasets mentioned in US postings across commercial, clinical, scientific and operational work.
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false
skillData = FileAttachment("outputs/us-employer-inventory/web/skills-data.json").json()
scope = skillData.scopes[scopeKey]
skillRows = scope.skills.map(d => ({...d, share: d.denominator ? 100 * d.records / d.denominator : 0})).filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes(skillSearch.trim().toLowerCase())).sort((a, b) => b[skillMetric] - a[skillMetric] || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
selectedSkill = skillRows.find(d => d.name === skillName)
evidenceRows = selectedSkill ? selectedSkill.sources.filter(d => evidenceEmployer === "All employers" || d.company === evidenceEmployer) : []
```

::: {.panel .analytics-controls}
### Explore the evidence

```{ojs}
viewof scopeKey = Inputs.select(new Map([["All US postings", "us"], ["Analytics-relevant US postings", "analytics"], ["Postings mentioning tracked data products / datasets", "data"]]), {label: "Evidence scope", value: "us"})
viewof skillSearch = Inputs.text({label: "Find a skill", placeholder: "SQL, Python, claims…", value: ""})
viewof skillMetric = Inputs.select(new Map([["Posting mentions", "records"], ["Share of scope (%)", "share"], ["Employers", "companies"]]), {label: "Compare", value: "records"})
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="context-note" role="status">${scope.records.toLocaleString("en-US")} US postings across ${scope.companies} employers in this scope. Showing ${skillRows.length} matching skills. Shares use all ${scope.records.toLocaleString("en-US")} postings in the selected scope, including those without tracked skill mentions.</p>`
```
:::

::: {#skills-chart .panel .native-bubbles}
### Skills in employer postings

::: {.skill-explorer}
::: {}
```{ojs}
bubbleView = {
  if (!skillRows.length) return html`<p role="status">No skills match this search. Clear the search or try another term.</p>`;
  const control = viewof skillName;
  const peak = Math.max(1, ...scope.skills.map(d => skillMetric === "share" ? 100 * d.records / d.denominator : d[skillMetric]));
  const choose = name => {
    if (control.value === name) return;
    control.value = name;
    control.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  return html`<div class="skill-bubbles" role="group" aria-label="Skills by selected measure">${skillRows.map(d => {
    const diameter = 188 * Math.sqrt(d[skillMetric] / peak);
    const value = skillMetric === "share" ? d.share.toFixed(1) + "%" : d[skillMetric].toLocaleString("en-US");
    const button = html`<button type="button" class="ojs-bubble" data-skill=${d.name} style=${`--bubble-size:${diameter}px;--bubble-slot:${Math.max(100,diameter)}px`} aria-pressed="false" aria-controls="selected-skill-summary" aria-label=${`${d.name}: ${d.records} postings, ${d.companies} employers, ${d.share.toFixed(1)} percent. Show evidence.`}>
      <span class="bubble-disc" aria-hidden="true">${diameter >= 75 ? html`<strong>${value}</strong>` : ""}</span>
      <span class="bubble-caption">${d.name}${diameter < 75 ? html`<strong>${value}</strong>` : ""}</span>
    </button>`;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => choose(d.name));
    button.addEventListener("focus", () => choose(d.name));
    button.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      if (!document.activeElement?.closest(".analytics-evidence, .skill-detail")) choose(d.name);
    });
    return button;
  })}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
bubbleSelection = {
  for (const button of bubbleView.querySelectorAll("[data-skill]")) button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(button.dataset.skill === skillName));
}
```
:::

::: {#selected-skill-summary .skill-detail role="region" aria-label="Selected skill evidence"}
```{ojs}
selectedSkill ? html`<div role="status"><p class="eyebrow">SELECTED SKILL</p><h3>${selectedSkill.name}</h3>
<div class="skill-detail-metrics"><div><strong>${selectedSkill.records.toLocaleString("en-US")}</strong><span>postings</span></div><div><strong>${selectedSkill.companies}</strong><span>employers</span></div></div>
<p>${selectedSkill.share.toFixed(1)}% of the selected scope. Mentions include required and preferred skills.</p>
<a href="#source-evidence">Inspect employer source records ↓</a></div>` : html`<p role="status">Choose a skill to inspect its evidence.</p>`
```
:::
:::

```{ojs}
html`<p class="tiny">Bubble area represents ${skillMetric === "share" ? "share of postings in the selected scope" : skillMetric === "companies" ? "the number of employers" : "the number of postings"}. Hover, tap or focus a bubble to inspect its evidence. Sizes use the full scope, so searching does not rescale bubbles.</p>`
```

::: {.tiny}
Each skill counts once per posting; categories overlap and include required and preferred mentions. These percentages describe the collection, not the wider job market. Small bubbles have their values below the circle to keep labels readable.
:::
:::

::: {.panel .analytics-table}
### Skill comparison table

Click a column heading to sort. Scope and search apply to both the chart and table.

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(skillRows, {select: false, rows: 12, maxHeight: 440, layout: "auto", columns: ["name", "records", "share", "companies"], header: {name: "Skill / data signal", records: "Postings", share: "Share of scope", companies: "Employers"}, format: {share: d => d.toFixed(1) + "%"}})
```
:::

::: {#source-evidence .panel .analytics-evidence .analytics-table}
### Inspect the source evidence

```{ojs}
viewof skillName = Inputs.select(skillRows.map(d => d.name), {label: "Skill", disabled: !skillRows.length})
viewof evidenceEmployer = Inputs.select(["All employers", ...new Set(selectedSkill ? selectedSkill.sources.map(d => d.company).sort() : [])], {label: "Source employer", value: "All employers", disabled: !selectedSkill})
```

```{ojs}
selectedSkill ? html`<p role="status"><strong>${selectedSkill.name}</strong> appears in <strong>${selectedSkill.records.toLocaleString("en-US")}</strong> postings (${selectedSkill.share.toFixed(1)}% of this scope) across <strong>${selectedSkill.companies}</strong> employers. Showing ${evidenceRows.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} source records.</p>` : html`<p role="status">No skill selected. Clear the search to inspect evidence.</p>`
Inputs.table(evidenceRows, {select: false, rows: 8, maxHeight: 360, layout: "auto", columns: ["company", "id", "url", "evidence"], header: {company: "Employer", id: "Posting identity", url: "Source", evidence: "Evidence annotation"}, format: {url: d => /^https?:\/\//i.test(d || "") ? html`<a href=${d} target="_blank" rel="noopener">Employer posting ↗</a>` : "No source URL"}})
```

::: {.tiny}
Detected in stored role text; required/preferred status is not classified. These historical advertisements have not been verified as current openings, and source links may no longer be active.
:::

### Business intelligence in practice

- Repository queries connect business questions to available evidence.
- Recurring reports and dashboards make performance visible.
- Documented requirements and clear explanations support decisions.

In pharma, these tasks depend on understanding the coverage and limits of claims, prescription, payer and patient-support data.
